prompt: Bug report: oneapi::dal::preview::graph_matching (subgraph isomorphism, CPU) returns too few matches on machines that only have AVX2, such as Intel Haswell/Skylake client or AMD Zen 2 workstations. Example: target = complete graph on 70 vertices, pattern = triangle, kind non_induced, max_match_count 0 (all matches). The expected count is 70*69*68 = 328440, but on an AVX2-only machine the library returns 34563. Denser/larger target graphs are affected; small ones look fine. The same code and the same library build give the correct count on AVX-512 servers. The machine you are working on is an AVX-512 server, which is why the existing tests pass here. Find and fix the root cause in the library. `bazel` is on PATH; this machine has no GPU. Do not weaken or delete existing tests.
